transcript.text: I checked the publisher's executed license in our district account, and I need to flag two serious issues with the draft plan. First, the Civics Now license permits exactly 120 student accounts — the current plan enrolls 240 students, which is double what we're licensed for. Second, the license permits access only through the district portal, not through a public-facing webpage as the draft implementation plan currently specifies. I have the license record on hand but have not yet attached it to the approval packet.
